citations.assessment: The digital witness reads Rabbi Chunya in the name of Binyamin bar Levi. This differs from the Rav Huna in Esther Rabbah and in Heilprin’s text.
Rav Huna explicitly reports Binyamin bar Levi regarding the north and south winds.
The digital parallel indeed gives Rabbi Yehoshua son of Rabbi Binyamin bar Levi. Heilprin calls the longer attribution erroneous. The three sources transmit distinct name forms.
The wind homily here is transmitted by Rabbi Yose in Rabbi Binyamin bar Levi’s name.
Binyamin bar Levi is the reporting voice. Rabbi Yitzchak and Rabbi Immi were sitting and raising a question.
